text: The Nepal Insurance Authority (NIA) is the statutory regulator of Nepal’s insurance and reinsurance market, established under the Insurance Act, 2079 (2022). It replaced the former Insurance Board (Beema Samiti) to modernize insurance supervision, enhance market stability, and improve consumer outcomes. NIA is tasked with licensing, setting capital and solvency standards, supervising market conduct, approving products, regulating distribution, managing consumer complaints, and driving financial inclusion and market modernization.
